userStories.title: Add digest config section
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add a new 'digest' section to config.yaml so that refined digest settings can be configured (format, max_topics, low_activity_percentile, notable_threads, claims limits).
acceptanceCriteria: config.yaml has new 'digest' section with format, what_matters, top_discussions, notable_threads, and claims settings
Config parser loads and validates new digest settings
Default values work when settings are omitted

userStories.title: Create What Matters Synthesizer AI prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I want the digest to analyze all posts and generate a 'What Matters' summary table with priority icons, topic, impact (~50 chars), and status (community + official response).
acceptanceCriteria: New AI prompt accepts all summarized posts as input
Output is JSON array with priority (urgent/developing/informational), topic, impact, status fields
Identifies 3-6 most significant topics across all posts
Priority icons mapped: urgent=red, developing=yellow, informational=green

userStories.title: Create Story Narrator AI prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I want each post to have a 'The Story' narrative section that explains what happened and why it matters in 2-4 sentences.
acceptanceCriteria: New AI prompt takes post + comments + existing summary as input
Outputs 2-4 sentence narrative paragraph
Narrative explains what happened and why it matters
Integrated into summarization step

userStories.title: Create Notable Thread Identifier AI prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I want each post to show 2-4 notable conversation threads that highlight interesting discussions.
acceptanceCriteria: New AI prompt analyzes comment threads
Outputs 2-4 notable thread descriptions as bullet points
Threads describe specific insights or developments (not generic summaries)
Respects max_per_post config setting

userStories.title: Add claim verification status to extraction
userStories.description: As a user, I want claims to show verification markers (check or question mark) and confidence percentages so I can assess reliability.
acceptanceCriteria: Claim extraction includes verification_status (verified/unverified) and confidence percentage
Format: verified claims show checkmark, unverified show question mark
Top 3-5 claims shown per post based on config
Confidence percentage displayed next to each claim

userStories.title: Implement post importance ranking
userStories.description: As a user, I want posts ranked by AI-determined importance (not just score) so the most significant discussions appear first.
acceptanceCriteria: AI ranks posts by importance considering multiple factors
Posts ordered by importance rank in output
Bottom 20% (configurable) identified for low-activity section
Ranking persists through digest generation

userStories.title: Create digest-formatter utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a new digest-formatter.ts utility that formats all digest sections to match the TEMPLATE-REFINED.md structure.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/utils/digest-formatter.ts created
Formats 'What Matters' table with priority icons
Formats 'Top Discussions' section with proper headers and metadata
Formats per-post sections (The Story, Notable Threads, High-Confidence Claims)
Formats 'Low-Activity Posts' as collapsible details section

userStories.title: Enhance Conflicting Viewpoints generation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Conflicting Viewpoints section to show more specific opposing viewpoints per topic, synthesized from posts with different stances.
acceptanceCriteria: AI produces specific, contrasting viewpoints (not generic)
Table format with Topic, View A, View B columns
Viewpoints sourced from posts discussing same topic with different stances
Enhanced from current basic implementation

userStories.title: Update Emerging Patterns confidence display
userStories.description: As a user, I want Emerging Patterns to show AI-stated confidence percentages in the standard format.
acceptanceCriteria: Confidence percentage comes from AI's stated confidence
Format matches: **Pattern Name** (N% confidence) with description on next line
Patterns display correctly in final digest

userStories.title: Implement Low-Activity Posts collapsible section
userStories.description: As a user, I want low-activity posts (bottom 20% by importance) shown in a collapsible section with abbreviated format.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom 20% of posts by importance go to Low-Activity section
Uses HTML <details> tag for collapsible display
Abbreviated format: title, score, one-line summary
Percentile threshold configurable via config

userStories.title: Update digest workflow with new steps
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the digest workflow updated to include the new steps: summarize-with-story, extract-verified-claims, synthesize-what-matters, rank-posts, generate-refined-digest.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow follows: fetch -> summarize-with-story -> extract-verified-claims -> synthesize-what-matters -> rank-posts -> generate-refined-digest -> save
All new AI prompts integrated into appropriate steps
Workflow produces complete refined digest output
Uses old.reddit.com URLs for post links

userStories.title: End-to-end test: refined digest matches template
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify the generated digest matches TEMPLATE-REFINED.md structure with all sections present and correctly formatted.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated digest has all template sections in correct order
What Matters table displays correctly with icons
Top Discussions posts have The Story, Notable Threads, High-Confidence Claims
Low-Activity Posts section is collapsible
Conflicting Viewpoints and Emerging Patterns formatted correctly
